name: Saas Toolkit
description:
The complete Claude Code toolkit for SaaS founders. 15 skills and 4 agents covering the full development cycle - from spec to launch. Build with Next.js, Supabase Auth, Vercel, PostHog, Polar.sh, and Vercel AI
  SDK. Includes skills for project setup, auth, database, billing, UI, AI integration, analytics, security, landing pages, SEO, branding, content, deployment, and launch readiness. Agents: saas-mentor (guidance),
  prd-writer (specs), saas-reviewer (code review), qa-tester (test plans).
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills** and **6 agents**.

- **Skills** (7): `ncode-anti-vibe-coding` (Prevents AI-generated look in web and mobile apps), `ncode-prd` (Guides the user through creating a Product Requirements Document for their SaaS), `ncode-project-setup` (Sets up a new SaaS project with the exact nCode Golden Stack), `ncode-prompt-guide` (Teaches non-developers how to write effective prompts for Claude Code), `ncode-rls-guard` (Enforces Row Level Security on every Supabase table and Firebase Security Rules on every collection), `ncode-shipping-checklist` (Pre-production checklist before deploying to Vercel/App Store), `ncode-webhook-handler` (Creates production-ready webhook handlers for Polar, RevenueCat, or any payment/event provider)
- **Agents** (6): `code-reviewer` (Reviews code for security, performance, and best practices before shipping), `design-director` (Generates a project-specific design system (DESIGN.md) from the PRD), `prd-writer` (Generates Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) from idea descriptions), `project-manager` (Manages the full GitHub project lifecycle - creates repo and kanban board from PRD, helps pick issues, creates…), `qa-tester` (Tests features and finds edge cases in SaaS applications), `saas-mentor` (SaaS business mentor + nCode course guide for solo founders)

Installs with `claude plugin install saas-toolkit@claude-community` from `dangogit/saas-toolkit` (`plugins/ncode-saas-toolkit`).
